GRAIN NEUTRAL ALCOHOL
As Pure As It Can Get. Endless Possibilities.
ISO 9001 CERTIFIED MANUFACTURER OF INDUSTRIAL GRADE & FUEL ETHANOL
Some of the World’s
Purest & Cleanest Alcohol
Golden Triangle recognizes the importance of providing high-quality alcohol products that take into consideration both customers and the environment. Finding the ideal source for grain neutral spirits and specially denatured alcohol can be challenging, and it is essential to choose a partner that consistently offers exceptional quality alcohol while adapting to evolving requirements.
Golden Triangle is committed to delivering the necessary solutions without compromising on quality or customer service. The state-of-the-art distillation facility at Golden Triangle exclusively processes Mid-American, locally grown #2 yellow corn. This meticulous process involves distilling the grain alcohol seven times, resulting in some of the world’s purest and cleanest alcohol available. Golden Triangle takes pride in this process and is dedicated to continually refining and improving methods to better serve the market.
Experts In Our Field
GRAIN NEUTRAL SPIRITS
Golden Triangle’s production facility ranks among the world’s most elite for grain neutral spirits. Utilizing a 6-column distillation process, Golden Triangle produces kosher, gluten-free, and high-quality spirits for discerning consumers.
